verdict.rationale: Godot explicitly supports headless CLI operation (`godot --headless`) for automation and scripted editor tasks, and documents command-line workflows and EditorScript execution, which are prerequisites for CI test runs against the real engine. However, there is no evidence of an official unit/integration testing framework (e.g., GUT) or documented CI test-runner examples/integration in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: official testing framework docs, CI pipeline examples, evidence of test-result reporting from headless runs.
